comment: please edit this file to configure the eBook generation. This file is template only, you can copy it to configuration.json and edit the copy to configure the eBook generation. And remove all the comment line in the copy file.

custom_toc.comment: when enabled=true, render chapters according to chapter_id order
custom_toc.comment_override_appendix: when enabled=true, override the appendix render setting in the configuration.json, override_appendix is available when is_from_creator is true and custom_toc is enabled

appendix.comment: always appears at the end of the table of contents, if location does not contain appendix path, move file to the appendix folder, if is_from_creator is true, this section is available, otherwise it is not available and use the config in the custom_appendix section

itemappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

itemsetappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

characterappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

factionappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

realmsappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

abilitiesappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

skillsetappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

definitionappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

relationsappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

timelineappendix.1: ecxactly location of file,based on root

appendix.is_from_creator: true/false,if true, appendix only need render input of name ToC, if false, add the corresponding {tag}appendix structure

render.comment: based on display setting in the creator of novel, if the setting is hidden then the value is false, otherwise true

path.comment: All HTML/XHTML files will be placed in the corresponding directory.

path.name: name of appendix folder
path.is_contain_appendix_chapter_in_folder: true/false, if true, the folder contains appendix chapter, otherwise false, this section is require custom_toc is enabled to change value, default value is true(If the value of custom_toc is true, then the files_in_appendix entry will be active.)

path_of_file.id: id of the files, this section is required, and it can change the order of the files in the appendix folder(and can change manually in the configuration)
path_of_file.name_in_toc: name of file in toc, if is_contain_appendix_chapter_in_folder is true, this section is required, otherwise optional

custom_appendix.comment: custom appendix folder, all files in this folder will be placed in the corresponding directory, the path(key) is the path of the appendix folder, the value is the name of the appendix folder in the ToC, if you want to add a new appendix folder, just add a new key-value pair here, and create a new folder in the root directory with the same name as the key.
